title: Common Transactional Crop Lifecycle State Carrier
purpose: Introduce the smallest source-bound crop-owned physical state carrier needed by the qualified root/ET path and make it compatible with the existing generic F-KT transaction layer, without implementing crop evolution, calendar scheduling or option-dependent root history.

state_semantics.crop_emerged: committed crop lifecycle state visible to root/ET views
state_semantics.development_stage: committed crop development state; finite but otherwise not range-restricted by this carrier
state_semantics.leaf_area_index: committed crop structural state; finite and nonnegative
state_semantics.inactive_state: still remains a valid committed state; downstream inactive routes may ignore DVS/LAI but the carrier itself remains finite and deterministic

transaction_semantics: clone must produce an independent physical copy
F-KT committed initialization must accept the carrier through transaction_state_t
F-KT checkpoint capture must preserve exact crop state and provenance
trial mutation of a checkpoint snapshot must never mutate committed state
discarding a trial must leave committed state bitwise unchanged
replaying the same trial transformation from the same checkpoint must reproduce the same crop state bitwise
validation: leaf_area_index must be finite and nonnegative
no implicit day, date, year or crop-calendar validation belongs in this carrier
qualification_tests: trial mutation then discard leaves committed state unchanged
A/B/A replay from the same checkpoint is bitwise deterministic
forbidden: blind import from F-WOF04 through F-WOF10
downstream_if_qualified: Add option-dependent root-history carriers separately, then create a crop-owner read-only view/composition layer feeding F-WOF17 and F-WOF18.
